title: The Fork
concept: A fork is one piece attacking two enemy pieces at the same time. Your opponent can only move one of them to safety, so you win the other.
tip: Look for a square where one piece — especially a knight or a pawn — hits two enemy pieces at once.

feedback.correct: Perfect! Your piece attacks two enemy pieces at the same time — that is a fork!
feedback.hint: Look for a square where your piece attacks two enemy pieces at once.
feedback.reveal: The move attacks two pieces simultaneously. The opponent can only save one of them!
